subject.title: Normal tool text outputs can degrade to “(see attached image)” placeholders in agent context

question: Is #98955 plus the current beta evidence enough to close #96857 now, or should #96857 remain the canonical umbrella until the open non-trailing projection and provider/media-placeholder PRs land or split?
rationale: Automation can prove a major partial fix on main, but deciding whether the remaining related PRs are part of this canonical user problem or separate narrower issues requires maintainer judgment and proof sufficiency.

options.title: Keep #96857 Canonical
options.body: Leave the issue open while #99524, #99756, and #100795 resolve or are explicitly split, preventing a premature close from stale PR #96895.

options.title: Close After #98955
options.body: Close this issue as fixed by the trailing-result aggregate fix and require remaining reports to continue only in narrower issues such as #99481 and #99241.

options.title: Split And Reword
options.body: Retitle or comment on #96857 to narrow the fixed aggregate-truncation part, then move provider/media and non-trailing fresh-result follow-up to their canonical items.

recommendation.title: Keep #96857 Canonical
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open while #99524, #99756, and #100795 resolve or are explicitly split, preventing a premature close from stale PR #96895.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged same-helper fix that created the current close-or-keep-open boundary and are the strongest owner for the aggregate-recovery decision.
